caption: The drawing features thirteen small rectangular fabric swatches, each with a different pattern and color, arranged in four centered rows on a plain, light beige background. The first row consists of four red or deep pink fabric squares labeled A, B, C, and D, each featuring a unique yellow, orange, or reddish design. The second row contains four more red or pink squares labeled E, F, G, and H, with varied detailed patterns in yellow, white, or darker red, and some intricate line work or motifs. The third row includes four squares labeled I, J, K, and L; two are similar in hue to the rows above, while J and K are much lighter with white backgrounds and small blue motifs. The last row consists of a single, horizontally-oriented rectangular swatch labeled M, colored green with a dark green or black abstract, possibly floral, pattern. Each swatch is slightly raised and shadowed to give a three-dimensional effect, and labeled with a capital letter directly below it. The overall composition is evenly spaced and balanced on the page.
